name: Numerical Analysis for Chemical Engineers
description: Introduction to vector space. Estimation and round-off error calculations. Existence of solution to linear algebraic equations. Direct and iterative methods to solve system of linear algebraic equations such as Gauss elimination, Gauss Jordan, LU decomposition, Gauss-Seidel method, etc. Solutions to sparse matrix system. Ill-conditioned and well-conditioned systems, matrix conditioning. Solutions to non-linear algebraic equations: root finding methods, Newton method, optimization-based methods. Convergence analysis for iterative methods. Numerical interpolation and curve fitting. Numerical integration and differentiation. Ordinary differential equations initial and boundary value problems (ODE-IVP, ODE-BVP): Basic concepts; Solution of ODE-IVP and ODE-BVP via implicit and explicit methods; Existence and uniqueness of solution. Solution of partial differential equations (PDEs). Application of numerical methods for solving chemical engineering problems.
